about: SWOT RiverSP reach width as a check on reach height at a leveed reach
text: Seen while exploring calendar 2024 at reach 74210000331 against USGS-07374000, Version D. Width does rise with stage (rank correlation +0.744 on the 47 unflagged pairs; +0.740 on all 50), by about 8.03 m of width per metre of stage over a 1.64 to 10.33 m range, but the spread of width about that line is 25.4 m, which is the width change of roughly three metres of stage. And the two passes whose heights were far off (2024-10-30 and 2024-03-26, named in a draft page from EXPLORATION-0001, not signed) have unremarkable widths: ranks 12 and 8 of 50 from the narrowest, while the widths furthest from the median are on other dates with ordinary flags. So at this reach width neither tracks stage finely enough to check a height nor singles out the passes with bad heights. What would reopen it: a reach whose banks slope, where width changes by much more per metre of stage than its pass-to-pass scatter.
from: an exploration: what it says was seen while exploring and is not a tested claim
